name: SES S.A.
summary: SES S.A. provides satellite-based data transmission capacity and ancillary services worldwide. The company offers content connectivity solutions, including network spanning satellite and ground infrastructure to create, deliver, and manage video and data solutions. It also provides data connectivity services through its fleet of geostationary earth orbit and medium earth orbit satellites, and ground infrastructures to the aviation, media and broadcast, cloud, cruise, energy, government, maritime, and telco and mobile network operator industries.
